checks.title: Confirm inventory job and owners
checks.instructions: Name the merchant, catalog owner, store operations owner, buyer impact, service deadline, and approved decision path.

checks.title: Bind exact variant and location
checks.instructions: Record store, market, product, variant, inventory item, and location IDs. Explain which location can fulfill this market; do not sum ineligible locations.

checks.title: Set stock and oversell rules
checks.instructions: Identify the authoritative available, committed, on-hand, and incoming source, sync lag, oversell policy, adjustment permission, and supplier lead time if used. Unknown remains unknown.

checks.title: Bind two ready Crews
checks.instructions: Record existing or reviewed new Catalog & Merchandising Analyst and Store Operations Coordinator IDs, skills, and setup status. One Crew may fill both only with separate outputs.

checks.title: Probe real source access
checks.instructions: Read one authorized ProductVariant, InventoryItem, InventoryLevel for the exact location, and market storefront observation; test warehouse or supplier source when a claim needs it.

checks.title: Validate variant/location handoff
checks.instructions: Run the bundled validator on both artifacts. Reject wrong location, noninteger quantity, approved action without approval, and executed action without receipt.

checks.title: Review concrete plan
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source field scope, authority, artifact paths, exact proposed change, approval owner, cost, and manual route before Builder applies it.

checks.title: Run a real case manually
checks.instructions: Use one real authorized variant/location, preserve run IDs and validator results, and record merchant decision or blocker. Fictional fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Record action and retest
checks.instructions: Keep stable case/action IDs, old and proposed values, approval, provider receipt, inventory re-read, storefront retest, and next owner check; prevent duplicate adjustments.

checks.title: Choose recurrence
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or a reviewed schedule/event route with source re-read, deduplication, concurrency, cost, and notifications. Test it before enabling; setup does not adjust stock.
